page.layout: One page of text, single column of Latin with Hebrew entries; Hebrew catchword-style header at top centre with page number at top right; Hebrew/Latin dictionary entries run down the left side, with the Hebrew lemmas at the left edge of the column; a Hebrew catchword "סלק" at lower right.

main_text.p: in cantu fuisse elevandam, & simul animos ad Deum. Mihi potius communis pausa nota, quòd ibi omnium vocum aquabilis esset pausa, & communis quædam cantus quasi Prostratio, quod & ipsum gravitati & suavitati in canendo non parum servit.
סַלֵּן Condonare, Remittere. Niphal נִסְלַח Condonari.
סָלַל Aggerare, Contumulare, Viam sternere & elevare. Pihel סִלְסֵל Extollere. Hithpahel הִסְתּוֹלֵל Extollere seipsum.
סְלֻלָּה f. Agger, aggesta terra moles: plural. סְלֻלּוֹת Aggeres.
מְסִלָּה f. Aggesta, Strata, Trita via: plural. מְסִלּוֹת Via, Aggeres.
סִלּוֹן סִלּוֹן m. Spina: plur. סִלּוֹנִים.
סֶלַע סֶלַע m. Petra: plur. סְלָעִים.

page.notes: Hebrew lemmas at the left edge are partly cut off by the scan edge and are reconstructed as best as legible; several Hebrew vowel points are doubtful. The final catchword "סלק" at lower right is printed in larger type and is treated as a catchword in the text.
